coverageNotes: All dated event cards were freshly researched from primary organizer/venue pages; no old cards were relabeled.
Travel minutes are editorial estimates from central Chicago, not live traffic measurements. All are within 90 minutes; no road trips included.
Same-day repeat performances are consolidated. Ongoing exhibitions expand only when explicit season and open-day evidence support each date.
Check source is used for unpublished prices and daily tournament times. A buy-tickets link is not a guarantee of remaining inventory.

Excluded Oracle of Evergreen and Morning Glories rather than rely on inconsistent or unavailable individual event detail pages.
STEM event and venue pages agree on opening at 10 AM but conflict on closing time; card gives the supported opening and asks users to check timed-entry slots.
Aquí closing calendar summary ends 4 PM but detailed program continues through 4:30 PM; card follows detailed schedule.
